features.name: local net flow
features.formula: observed country net flow at t
features.reason: The target's recent history gives the model an autoregressive anchor.

features.name: local load
features.reason: Demand pressure changes the likely transfer requirement.

features.name: local imbalance
features.reason: Large imbalance separates stable transfer from directional stress.

features.name: local load residual
features.reason: Forecast misses can precede unexpected flow changes.

features.name: global net flow
features.reason: A node's forecast is conditioned on the system-wide state.

features.name: global load
features.reason: Shared demand conditions propagate through interconnectors.

features.name: global imbalance
features.reason: System-wide directional pressure provides context around a node.

features.name: global residual
features.reason: Collective forecast error can signal an unstable operating period.

features.name: degree centrality
features.reason: A node with more neighbors has more pathways for pressure to move.

features.name: closeness centrality
features.reason: A node's graph proximity gives a compact connectivity context.

features.name: betweenness centrality
features.formula: fraction of shortest paths through node
features.reason: Bridge nodes can matter to rerouting decisions.
